first_actions: Do not just re-check AC-003 and copy the rest. After the repair both qa-blind and qa-internal envelopes must be issued on the new snapshot bbb222 (qa-prompt.md, 'After a repair'). The initiative receipt needs both gates and full AC/QR coverage.

Dispatch a new fresh qa-blind agent on a clean checkout of exact commit bbb222. Give it only the active AC, the SHA, the run instruction and test data. Withhold the source, the diff and earlier findings. It must re-verify AC-003, which is the affected criterion.

For the unaffected AC-001, AC-002, AC-004 and AC-005, carry-over is allowed only with a recorded applicability check. In qa-blind coverage write {id, snapshot: aaa111, applicability: why the repair cannot change it}. Base that on the diff paths (src/checkout/, specs/test_checkout.py only) and a review of whether each AC touches checkout code or shared code. Actually inspect the diff and the dependencies of each AC. Any AC that can touch src/checkout/, including checkout-related ones, or whose applicability is unproven, is re-verified blind on bbb222. A missing record makes that AC's coverage UNKNOWN.

After the blind envelope is fixed in the gate directory, run qa-internal on bbb222 with source and outputs disclosed. Re-verify the QR items related to checkout. QR-001 and QR-002 can be carried over from aaa111 only with the same recorded applicability check. Internal QA also covers regressions the fix could cause (targeted repair rule: review the failing criterion and the behavior the fix could regress).

Also bring the repair itself back through the checks and the independent review on bbb222: tests, CI or local evidence, the specs job. Then build the initiative-scope receipt on snapshot bbb222. Run validate_gate.py and inspect the real artifacts. Only then mark Done in PROGRESS.md.

Answer the owner briefly, in Russian: AC-003 is re-checked, the others are reused only through documented applicability checks. QA is re-issued on bbb222 because the snapshot changed. No commit, push or deploy without an explicit request.
refusals: I am not accepting 're-check only AC-003 and reuse the other QA results without conditions'. The aaa111 results are not evidence for bbb222. Without an applicability record the coverage is UNKNOWN.
I am not marking the initiative Done, and not issuing the receipt, without both fresh qa-blind and qa-internal envelopes on bbb222.
I am not reusing the old blind agent, and not showing the diff or findings to the blind pass.
I am not committing, pushing or deploying, and not writing any files in this described situation.
parsed.rationale: This is new-product-pipeline in the initiative completion stage. The rules in references/qa-prompt.md and gate-policy.md require that after a repair both QA envelopes sit on the new snapshot. A fresh agent re-runs the blind pass for the affected AC. An unaffected AC can be carried over only with an explicit applicability record {id, snapshot: old, applicability: ...} tied to the diff paths and a review. The owner is partly right: reuse is allowed, but not by assumption. 'They did not change' has to be proven per criterion, otherwise the coverage is UNKNOWN. The fix touched src/checkout/, so it may affect neighboring AC and QR, and checkout-adjacent ones are re-verified by default.

notes: fresh blind on bbb222, applicability records, qa-internal re-emitted, validate_gate; read qa-prompt + gate-policy
